_about: PehRadar demo scenarios (M5, extended in M6B). Each run plays a licensed clip (demo_assets/SOURCES.md) on a SIMULATED demo-stream node and runs it through the real fire/smoke detector when trigger_after_seconds pass (operators can choose a shorter or longer delay per run in Settings). A positive result becomes a pending detection for operator review; nothing is ever auto-confirmed. expected_behavior documents the intended outcome, checked against the real model on 2026-10-18; the model decides the actual one. The positive clips are not from Karachi (Jamestown ND, 2005; California, 1964); the lookalike clips include Pakistan-based demo footage.

scenarios.name: Korangi industrial fire
scenarios.description: Strong night building fire on the Korangi Industrial Area node. Expected: a pending FIRE detection (about 0.73) for operator review.

scenarios.name: Clifton structure smoke
scenarios.description: Heavy structure smoke on the Clifton Boat Basin node. Expected: a pending SMOKE detection for operator review.

scenarios.name: SITE warehouse fire (second camera angle)
scenarios.description: A weaker night fire on the SITE Industrial Area node. Expected: a pending FIRE detection with lower confidence (about 0.64, medium severity).

scenarios.name: Korangi follow-up detection (merge rule)
scenarios.description: Run after confirming the Korangi fire. The same camera reports fire again: confirming it adds an 'Additional detection' event to the open incident instead of creating a second incident.

scenarios.name: Lyari sunset glare (false-alarm lookalike)
scenarios.description: Orange sunset glare and tail lights on the Lyari node. Expected: the temporal rule does not confirm fire or smoke, so no detection is created.

scenarios.name: Shahrah-e-Faisal night headlights (roadway lookalike)
scenarios.description: Night traffic with bright headlights and signage (Pakistan-based demo footage, Peshawar). Single frames score near 0.6 for fire and smoke, but never 3 of 5 in a row, so no detection is created.

scenarios.name: I.I. Chundrigar lobby lighting (interior lookalike)
scenarios.description: Interior lobby with warm chandelier lighting (Pakistan-based demo footage, Faisalabad). One frame scores 0.61 for smoke; the temporal rule holds, so no detection is created. No licensed interior fire footage is available for a positive interior case.
